entry.title: Follow a ball down the ramps
entry.summary: The authors describe a ball tracker with ramps to watch and a ball to retrieve. Their standing example requires a large, stable support, with a ball and parts suitable for mouthing.
entry.cue: Your baby watches a moving ball or wants to drop it and find it again.
detail: In the body example, the baby pulls up, drops the ball, bends to retrieve it, and repeats. Watching the ball is also part of the interest.

The appendix lists the activity from creeping, around 8 to 10+ months; it does not require every baby to use the standing version. The authors choose activities by the baby’s current movement and interest.
